name: FAW Jiefang Group Co.,Ltd
summary: FAW Jiefang Group Co.,Ltd, together with its subsidiaries, manufactures and sells light, medium, and heavy trucks and buses in China. The company provides engines, auto parts, and accessories; and technical services. It also engages in technology research and development activities. The company was formerly known as Faw Car Co., Ltd. and changed its name to FAW Jiefang Group Co.,Ltd in May 2020. The company was founded in 1953 and is headquartered in Changchun, China. FAW Jiefang Group Co.,Ltd operates as a subsidiary of China FAW Group Co., Ltd.
